previous_observation_set: fixed stride plus every saturated pixel
coherent_previous_posterior: joint latent RBF posterior with noisy unsaturated likelihood and censored likelihood
sequential_residual: one-step advective propagation of centered previous draws plus finite-step innovation
observation_interpretation: observed censoring means latent temperature plus measurement noise exceeds ceiling
depth_definition: iterated four-neighbor erosion with boundary depth zero
preference_edges: same-component neighboring censored pixels with increasing depth
random_control: same undirected edges with randomized orientation
stage1_gp_posterior: same pooled converged latent-ESS standard posterior used in Stage 2
